diagrams.title: **The tools are agents
diagrams.caption: **The tools are agents.** The main agent doesn't know calculus; it knows that "math agent: solves equations" fits the question. Writing and science agents sit unused until a question needs them.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **Layers of expertise
diagrams.caption: **Layers of expertise.** One specialist serves many callers, and can itself call other specialists. Each layer only needs to know the descriptions of the layer below.

diagrams.title: **One question, many hands
diagrams.caption: **One question, many hands.** A router fans the request out, specialists work in parallel (and occasionally consult each other), and an aggregator merges everything into one reply.
diagrams.svg:
<svg class="dimmable" viewBox="0 0 1100 380" aria-label="Data flow within a multi-agent system. User input goes to a router agent. The router sends tailored requests to three specialist agents in parallel: a specs agent, a price agent and a review agent, which can also talk to each other. Their results go to an aggregator, which produces the final output." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-brain" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-brain" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

diagrams.title: **A relay race
diagrams.caption: **A relay race.** Each agent waits for the previous one; total time is the sum of every step.

diagrams.title: **Everyone at once
diagrams.caption: **Everyone at once.** Total time is the time of the slowest agent, not the sum.

diagrams.caption: **Majority voting.** One agent's mistake is outvoted by the other two, as long as their mistakes are independent.

diagrams.title: **A real conversation
diagrams.caption: **A real conversation.** Unlike sequential (one direction) or parallel (no talking), collaborative agents push back on each other until every concern is met.
